title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. translated_title: 探索“有意识”的心灵：视觉-语言模型中的选择性访问与全局工作空间
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）整合视觉与文本信息，但其输出无法揭示内部的概念表征。全局工作空间理论（GWT）提出，信息从并行的大脑加工过程中被选择出来，整合进一个共享的工作空间，并可供专门化的加工过程使用。我们引入多模态概念透镜（MC-Lens）——一种多模态雅可比透镜，用于研究VLM概念处理中的上述功能。其视觉编码器透镜和语言解码器透镜将中间状态映射到由解码器输出词汇表定义的共享语义空间，以比较不同模态间概念的可及性。MC-Lens还支持内部概念干预，以检验被访问的概念在下游计算中所起的作用。（i）可及性与选择性访问：多模态概念信息在中间状态中是可读取的，并且能够根据任务需求被选择性访问。我们将“读出载体”从单一名称
tldr: 该论文提出多模态概念透镜（MC-Lens），通过将视觉编码器与语言解码器的中间状态映射到共享语义空间，并结合内部概念干预，揭示视觉-语言模型中概念的可及性与选择性访问机制，为全局工作空间理论在AI系统中的验证提供了工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), which maps intermediate states of vision encoders and language decoders into a shared semantic space and enables internal concept interventions, revealing selective concept access and global-workspace-like dynamics in vision-language models.
